limitations: Silver-vs-advisory comparison: neither side is a human-adjudicated ground truth.

The two sides cover disjoint review subsets: the deterministic verdict comes from the reviews the lexicon CAN judge, the reference from the blind items it cannot. Agreement therefore measures whether the blind part tells the same story as the visible part, not label accuracy.
The deterministic side reflects the bounded evidence sample the workbench returns, not every matched review.
Engineering exploration; not a phase gate and not a business-impact claim.
